main_text.p: rum, Felicem praedicavit. Pyhal. אַשֵּׁר Beatum fieri vel reddi.
אַשְׁרֵי m. p. Beatitates, Felicitates: Beatus: אַשְׁרֵיךָ Beatitates tuae, ô te beatum, O quàm beatus es.
אשור אשור f. Incessus, Gressus, plur. אַשְׁרִים.
אֲשֶׁר Qui, Quae, Quod, & utriusque gen. & numeri: Quòd, Quum, Quia.

אשיא Chald. Fundamenta, Esr.4.12. אשוחי Fundamenta ejus, Esr.6.3, Hinc. Verbum Hithpahel juxta quosdam התאשש Firmi, Fortes efforte, q.d. bene firmati & fundati, Jesa. 46.8. Alii, Viros prabete vos, quasi ab אִישׁ.
אשישות f. Lagena ampla: plur. אשישות, & masc. אשישים.
את Nota accusativi casus post verba activa; nominativi post passiva. Est & Praepositio, Cum:

page.notes: Hebrew and some Latin words are approximate; the bottom lines are partly faded. Catchword "Cum" is printed at the lower right and is given as printed in the text. Some Hebrew forms may contain errors and should be checked against the scan.
